Full marks may be obtained for answers to ALL questions. Mathematical formulae and tables produced by the GCE Board are allowed. enonce_intro_markdown:
A random variable $X$ takes its values in the set $\{0, 1, 2, 3, 4\}$ and has the distribution

| $x$ | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $P(X = x)$ | $a$ | $a$ | $a$ | $b$ | $b$ |

Given that $P(X \ge 2) = 3P(X < 2)$,

calculate

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) the values of the probabilities $a$ and $b$,
questions.corrige_markdown:
The probabilities of a distribution sum to 1:

$$3a + 2b = 1.$$

Now $P(X < 2) = P(X = 0) + P(X = 1) = 2a$ and $P(X \ge 2) = P(X = 2) + P(X = 3) + P(X = 4) = a + 2b$. The condition $P(X \ge 2) = 3P(X < 2)$ gives

$$a + 2b = 6a \;\Longrightarrow\; 2b = 5a \;\Longrightarrow\; b = \frac{5a}{2}.$$

Substituting in $3a + 2b = 1$: $3a + 5a = 1$, so $a = \dfrac{1}{8}$ and $b = \dfrac{5}{2} \times \dfrac{1}{8} = \dfrac{5}{16}$.

Check: $3a + 2b = \frac{3}{8} + \frac{5}{8} = 1$; $P(X < 2) = \frac{1}{4}$ and $P(X \ge 2) = \frac{3}{4} = 3 \times \frac{1}{4}$.

**$a = \dfrac{1}{8} = 0.125$ and $b = \dfrac{5}{16} = 0.3125$.**

First $E(X^2) = \sum x^2 P(X = x) = 0 + a + 4a + 9b + 16b = 5a + 25b = \dfrac{5}{8} + \dfrac{125}{16} = \dfrac{135}{16}$.

$$\operatorname{Var}(X) = E(X^2) - [E(X)]^2 = \frac{135}{16} - \left(\frac{41}{16}\right)^2 = \frac{2160 - 1681}{256} = \frac{479}{256} = 1.8711\ldots$$

$$\sigma = \sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(X)} = \frac{\sqrt{479}}{16} = 1.3679\ldots$$

**The standard deviation is $\dfrac{\sqrt{479}}{16} \approx 1.37$.**

Expectation is linear: $E(aX + b) = aE(X) + b$. Hence

$$E(Y) = 5E(X) + 3 = 5 \times \frac{41}{16} + 3 = \frac{205}{16} + \frac{48}{16} = \frac{253}{16}.$$

**$E(Y) = \dfrac{253}{16} = 15.8125 \approx 15.81$.**
